paper_title: A Composition Theorem for Conical Juntas
statement: by this, in order to speed up the search for height 3, we only optimised over those Ψ whose support coincides with that coming from the Composition Theorem – this LP has only 9 variables (i.e., equivalence classes of inputs), but well over 100,000 constraints (i.e., equivalence classes of conjunctions). context: The optimal height-2 certificate happens to have the same support as the certificate produced by our Composition Theorem starting with two height-1 certificates. Inspired by this, in order to speed up the search for height 3, we only optimised over those Ψ whose support coincides with that coming from the Composition Theorem – this LP has only 9 variables (i.e., equivalence classes of inputs), but well over 100,000 constraints (i.e., equivalence classes of conjunctions). It is open to analyse height 4.
